name: chart-radial-02
title: chart-radial-02
description: Delivery progress · Q2 2026. Completion against each team’s quarterly target.

meta.prompt:
Create a responsive analytics card titled “Team goal progress” with the muted eyebrow “Delivery progress · Q2 2026”. Fill available width up to 576px. Use a theme-aware card surface, rounded border, an 18px title, a prominent 30px semibold metric with tabular numerals, and a separated muted footer.

Show three concentric clockwise circular progress arcs starting at the top on full-circle background tracks, with rounded ends, a hidden 0–100 scale, and radii spanning 35% to 90%. Represent Platform at 86%, Design at 72%, and Product at 64% in three distinct colors. Include team legends and tooltips, the headline Three teams, and a footer explaining completion against quarterly targets.

Keep the plot 260px tall and responsive to the card width. Provide accessible chart navigation and value tooltips.

Build the chart with TanStack Charts. Use responsive chart geometry, theme-aware chart colors, a labeled legend, and pointer and keyboard value tooltips.
